reset.title: Reset two-step verification
reset.descriptionAvailable: For a lost phone, or a GitHub or Google account that isn’t theirs: turns off two-step verification and disconnects GitHub and Google, so they can sign in and set it up again.
reset.descriptionNone: Nothing to reset: they have no two-step verification, passkeys or connected GitHub or Google accounts.
reset.label: Reset
reset.dialogDescriptionWithAccounts: Their authenticator app and backup codes stop working, their connected GitHub and Google accounts are disconnected, and they're signed out everywhere. If their role requires it, they're asked to set up MFA again at their next sign-in.
reset.dialogDescription: Their authenticator app and backup codes stop working, and they're signed out everywhere. If their role requires it, they're asked to set up MFA again at their next sign-in.
reset.removePasskeys: {count, plural, one {Also remove their passkey} other {Also remove their # passkeys}}
reset.removePasskeysHint: Only when a passkey may be lost or stolen.

deactivate.title: Deactivate account
deactivate.description: Signs them out everywhere and blocks sign-in until reactivated. Their memberships and data stay.
deactivate.label: Deactivate
deactivate.confirmDescription: They are signed out everywhere and can’t sign in until an Admin reactivates the account.

reactivate.title: Reactivate account
reactivate.description: They can sign in again with their existing sign-in methods.
reactivate.label: Reactivate
reactivate.confirmDescription: They can sign in again and get back their access.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently removes the account, its sign-in methods and memberships, revokes the open invitations and invite links they sent and the open invitations addressed to them, and emails them that it was deleted. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.label: Delete
deleteAccount.dialogDescription: This permanently removes the account, revokes the open invitations and invite links they sent and those addressed to them, and emails them that it was deleted. Type their email address to confirm.

addUser.heading: Add a user
addUser.description: Create an account and email them a link to choose a password. Add them to companies or give them staff access afterwards, from their page.

form.description: They'll get an email with a link to choose a password. They aren't added to any company or given staff access.

addUser.created: Account created for {email}. We've emailed them a link to choose a password.
addUser.existing: {email} already has an account. Nothing was changed.
